## Original semantics and measurement limits

Worker serial is a local opaque batch ordinal, not a commit/generation/LSN. Actual index/size/selected count come from original cap64 ready-only collection. Shared apply/Write/Close boundary observations are copied to selected members; no unselected request or payload is retained. Postjoin validation checks identity, population, duplicate positions, shared batch receipts, explicit timestamp validity, same-owner chronology, unknown enums and error-category precedence.

All times use Go monotonic time.Since on the same immutable origin. These are observation brackets, not atomic channel-transition times. A delayed dequeue observation gives no positive lower bound on queue residence. Apply/Write/Close are inclusive wall intervals containing scheduling and instrumentation; nested intervals and shared rows must not be summed as exclusive per-request service. There is no CPU, lock-owner, exact queue residence or causality claim. Zero timestamp with Valid=true is legal. Cross-owner E1>D and receive<S1 are explicitly accepted.

The original function's setup-error Close return remains ignored, recorded separately. Normal Write/WriteSync and checked Close precedence are unchanged; original Close call counts and error objects returned to callers are preserved.
